title: Extreme Value Theory
description: The largest of many random draws follows its own law, and the rarest events are less rare than a bell curve says. Black swans happen.

puzzle.goal: Draw n numbers from a standard bell curve. Write the size m the largest of them typically has.
puzzle.name: Gumbel scaling
puzzle.method: The maximum sits where the tail's chance, about e^(−m²/2), times n is about one.
